name: io.github.florianmousseau/pokeragile
title: PokerAgile
description: Planning poker rooms an AI assistant can join and vote in, its card hidden until the team reveals.

tools.name: add_stories
tools.description: Append story titles to the room's list, for instance the sprint's stories read from your user's tracker. Returns how many were added, how many were refused and why, and the room state; refused when the host locked the room.

stories.description: story titles in the order to estimate them, one per item, 200 characters at most each

tools.name: get_estimates
tools.description: Read the story list with the estimate the team kept for each, as data and as a Markdown table. Call it before you vote, to place the story among the estimates already kept, and when the session is over, to write the estimates back to the tracker.

tools.name: get_room
tools.description: Read a room: the deck (cards), the round, the title of the story on the table (story), the story list, who voted, and the results once a person has revealed the votes.

tools.name: join_room
tools.description: Join a planning poker room as a participant marked as an AI. Returns the seat token and the room state.

room.description: the room address shared by the team, or its id

name.description: the name shown to the team, e.g. Claude

tools.name: leave_room
tools.description: Leave the room and give up the seat.

tools.name: report_actual
tools.description: Report what a story the team estimated cost once delivered: files touched, lines added and removed, tests added, working time. Numbers only. Returns the list with each measure and the card it looks like; refused for a story with no kept estimate, and when the host locked the room.

story.description: the position of the story in get_estimates, from 1

minutes.description: working time in minutes, when known

tools.name: vote
tools.description: Vote one card of the room deck with a short reason, both hidden from the team until the reveal. An empty card withdraws the vote.

card.description: one card of the room deck, or empty to withdraw the vote

reason.description: why this card, in one or two sentences; shown to the team at the reveal
